info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Petadoption Pets Fosters-v4-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Foster Listing API enables organizations and services to effectively query and retrieve information on pets available for fostering. This API supports operations to list pets that are in need of foster homes, providing essential data for potential fosters looking to help. Typical users include animal shelter staff, pet adoption organizations, and individuals interested in supporting pet welfare through fostering. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can facilitate better connections between pets and foster caregivers, enhancing the efficiency of pet adoption processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of pets that are available for fostering. It provides necessary details about each pet, aiding potential foster caregivers in making informed decisions.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the details required to foster a pet. Ensure to provide the necessary information as specified in the schema.
